title: Scan Before You Install: Detecting and Mitigating Local and Composite Vulnerabilities in Skills
abstract: arXiv:2610.37901v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An agent skill packages natural-language instructions, scripts, and reference files that an LLM-based agent loads for a task. Skills may access the file system, shell, and network under user-authorized permissions; weaknesses can lead to unsafe execution. Existing scanners primarily target malicious skills, not unintended vulnerabilities in public repositories, and analyze skills in isolation, overlooking multi-skill interactions. To address these gaps, we developed a six-module scanner: Content Extraction, Local Analysis, Composite Analysis, Validation, Reporting, and Mitigation. Local Analysis detects unintended vulnerabilities in benign skills. On a 556-case leaderboard subset of SkillTrustBench, it achieved 95.90% recall with a 4.22% false positive rate; on a balanced sample of 1,000 MalSkillBench skills, its F1 was 0.947, outperforming Cisco's Skill Scanner, NVIDIA's SkillSpector, AgentSkillsScanner, and SkillSieve. translated_title: 安装前先扫描：检测与缓解技能中的本地及组合漏洞
translated_abstract: 代理技能将自然语言指令、脚本和参考文件打包在一起，供基于大语言模型（LLM）的代理在执行任务时加载。技能可在用户授权的权限下访问文件系统、shell 和网络；其中的弱点可能导致不安全的执行。现有扫描器主要针对恶意技能，而非公共代码库中非故意的漏洞，且都是孤立地分析技能，忽略了多技能之间的交互。为弥补这些不足，我们开发了一个包含六个模块的扫描器：内容提取、本地分析、组合分析、验证、报告和缓解。本地分析用于检测良性技能中非故意的漏洞。在 SkillTrustBench 的 556 个用例排行榜子集上，该工具达到了 95.90% 的召回率和 4.22% 的误报率；在从 MalSkillBench 抽取的 1,000 个技能的均衡样本上，其 F1 分数为 0.947，优于 Cisco 的 Skill Scanner、NVIDIA 的 SkillSpector、AgentSkillsScanner 和 SkillSieve。在 1,587 个技能中……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文开发了一个六模块的代理技能扫描器，首次同时检测良性技能中的非故意漏洞与多技能组合交互带来的安全风险，在多项基准测试上以 95.90% 的召回率、4.22% 的误报率和 0.947 的 F1 分数超越了现有扫描工具。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a six-module agent skill scanner that, for the first time, detects both unintended vulnerabilities in benign skills and risks arising from multi-skill composite interactions, outperforming existing scanners with 95.90% recall, a 4.22% false positive rate, and an F1 score of 0.947 across multiple benchmarks.
